seo.title: Git Light — Free open-source desktop Git client with commit graph

featureList: Commit graph with virtualized SVG lanes
Clone from URL, init new repos, and folder discovery
Multi-repository tabs with aliases, reopen-closed, and keyboard navigation
Branch sidebar with grouped folders, bulk delete, and merge/rebase drag-and-drop
Text diffs plus image previews with zoom and lightbox
Git output log with executed commands
Embedded terminal at the repo root (⌘J)
English, Portuguese (Brazil), Simplified Chinese, Spanish, French, German and Japanese UI

faq.a: Yes. MIT licensed, no paid tier, no trial, no ads, no feature gates. Every feature listed on this page is available in the free build.

faq.q: Do I need a GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket account?
faq.a: No. There is no sign-in, no license key and no telemetry. Git Light works with any repository on disk and with any remote your own Git is already configured for, over HTTPS or SSH.
Yes. Browsing history, the commit graph, staging, diffs, commits, branches, merges, rebases and stashes are all local operations. Only fetch, pull, push and clone need network access.

faq.q: Does it come with its own Git install?
faq.a: No — it runs your system git binary, so your existing config, aliases, credential helper, SSH keys, hooks and .gitignore behaviour all apply unchanged.

faq.q: Can I use my existing repositories?
faq.a: Yes. Open any folder that contains a .git directory (or clone / init a new one). Git Light adds no proprietary index and writes no extra files into your repository.

faq.q: Does it work on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs?
faq.a: Apple Silicon (arm64) is fully supported. Intel Macs are not supported by the current builds — the release pipeline only produces an aarch64 .dmg. Windows x64 and Linux x86_64 builds are also available.

faq.q: macOS says the app is damaged or moves it to the Trash.
faq.a: That is Gatekeeper reacting to an ad-hoc signature, not a broken download — see the macOS install note.

English, Portuguese (Brazil), Simplified Chinese, Spanish, French, German and Japanese. The UI follows your OS language and can be switched in Settings. This website is available in the same seven languages.
